name: Habits
description: Daily habit tracking with streaks. The first route-owning reference plugin, extracted to prove the GitHub ingest loop.
author: atlibjorgvins

install.routes: src/routes (this repo's routes/ subtree is copied in verbatim)
install.note: fetch-plugins.sh clones this repo: routes/ is copied into twin's src/routes/, everything else into src/lib/plugins/habits/. Build-time, no runtime loader (see twin/docs/plugin-contract.md). This plugin now ships its own /tools/habits page under routes/.
